question: Should OpenClaw intentionally remove the manually enabled 2026.7.2-beta Workspaces plugin and have Doctor delete its retired state instead of preserving or migrating it into the forthcoming core dashboard?
rationale: The branch deliberately removes a beta-visible product surface and state rather than correcting an established stable-release defect; tests cannot choose the desired beta upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve removal with runtime proof
options.body: Accept removal of the unshipped experimental surface after redacted Doctor proof establishes that cleanup is limited to retired plugin state.

options.title: Preserve beta state temporarily
options.body: Keep the plugin or state until the core dashboard has a defined migration or explicit user-facing retention policy.

recommendation.title: Approve removal with runtime proof
recommendation.body: Accept removal of the unshipped experimental surface after redacted Doctor proof establishes that cleanup is limited to retired plugin state.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows this contributor carrying the removal and Doctor-transition design.
